name: Supabase Postgres Best Practices
description: Review PostgreSQL queries, indexes, schemas, connection pooling, and row-level security.
why: Provides concrete SQL examples and specialist references for PostgreSQL running anywhere, including locking and migrations.

setup.label: Project
setup.detail: Use with PostgreSQL; a Supabase account is not required. Installs the complete reference directory.

cautions: The upstream skill triggers broadly for database changes. Validate advice against your PostgreSQL version, schema, query plans, and workload before changing indexes or policies.
